findings.body: The loader counts tables before opening the insertion transaction. During an overlapping deployment, which the unchanged `src/forge/templates/conventions/deploy.md:5-6` permits, another instance can insert rows after these counts. The loader can then add demo records to a database that is no longer empty. Coordinate the check and insertion with concurrent writers.
findings.title: Coordinate the empty-table check with demo insertion

findings.body: The stack convention calls for a first-version loader, but the unchanged prototype instructions at `src/forge/templates/skill.md:118-127` do not tell the agent to build it or use `Words they use` for screen labels. The skill is outside this branch's scope; SPEC's skill work still needs that instruction.
findings.title: Later: SPEC must require first-version demo data and customer labels

findings.body: This convention describes clicking an element, writing feedback and pasting the output, but the unchanged prototype instructions at `src/forge/templates/skill.md:118-135` give salespeople no Agentation instructions. DEMO owns the skill text outside this branch's scope.
findings.title: Later: DEMO must add the pointing workflow to the skill
